verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Activepieces is MIT-licensed open source and can run on your own infrastructure, including a single container with an embedded database. That reduces lock-in and lets you take the platform with you. An API with API-key auth exists, but no evidence documents a data export feature or the formats it would produce. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of flows, tables, runs and connections; confirmation of open export formats (JSON/CSV); an account-exit or migration guide; independent hands-on confirmation of a full export.
